name: New Jersey Wire Cloth Company
old_description: Serving clientele of many industries, we ship worldwide with great lead times, large in-house inventory, as well as rush and emergency services. All of our products are backed by 100% guarantee.
about:
New Jersey Wire Cloth Company, Inc. was founded in 1962 in Cedar Grove, New Jersey. The business remains family-run, though the founders are not named in public materials. It began as a manufacturer of wire and plastic mesh screen belts for industrial applications.

The company produces a range of wire and plastic mesh belt products, including absorbent product belts, food product belts, and custom screen belts for non-woven, packing, and circular applications. Operations are housed in a manufacturing warehouse and office facility in Cedar Grove, where the firm maintains a large in-house inventory and offers emergency or rush production services with worldwide shipping. Specific headcount, facility size, and annual volume figures are not disclosed.

Primary customers operate in the commercial food, absorbent products, and laundry industries, though the company notes it serves clientele across many sectors. Examples include custom belts for food processing lines, absorbent product manufacturing, and laundry equipment.

The company emphasizes old-school customer service, answering all calls and emails directly and providing fast request-for-quote and purchase-order lead times. It backs all products with a 100% satisfaction guarantee and positions its depth of services and over six decades of experience as key differentiators for solving manufacturing downtime issues.

name: New Mexico Fabrics and Foam
old_description: Let R&R Trim Supply Help You Complete Your Upholstery Projects
about:
New Mexico Fabrics and Foam, also operating as R&R Trim Supply, is a family-owned business founded in 1985 by Robert and Ray Sanchez and Caroline Day in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company began as a supplier of upholstery materials, building on the Sanchez family's 52-year history in the upholstery trade.

The company maintains a warehouse open to the public near I-25 and Lomas Boulevard, stocking a broad inventory of decorative fabrics—including Western, Southwestern, and contract velvets—along with foam rubber, vinyl, leather, carpet, headliner material, convertible tops, and a range of fasteners, cleaners, and adhesives. It offers foam cutting to size and fulfills bulk orders for custom bolts and foam.

Customers span automotive, marine, furniture, and commercial upholstery sectors, as well as do-it-yourself enthusiasts. The business serves both high-volume upholstery shops and individual project needs.

The founders established the company on principles of customer service, satisfaction, and quality products, aiming to provide quality service and products for all upholstery and craft needs. Discounts and mill drops are available to help customers finish projects on a budget.

about:
New Prairie Solar operates from Urbana, Illinois, as the solar division of New Prairie Construction, a company established in 1988. The construction firm expanded into solar photovoltaics to meet demand for a reliable local provider in Central Illinois. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, installs, and services solar PV systems for residential, commercial, agricultural, and nonprofit clients. Its in-house team includes designers, technicians, and installers who handle array placement, sizing, and aesthetics, while partnering with a preferred licensed electrician for electrical work. New Prairie Solar also offers energy storage solutions and energy efficiency services, guiding customers through incentives and rebates with clear contracts.

The firm serves homeowners, businesses, farms, and nonprofit organizations throughout the Greater Urbana-Champaign area. Its portfolio includes projects for local residents and agricultural operations, with testimonials highlighting meticulous workmanship.

New Prairie Solar distinguishes itself through its construction heritage, applying building science knowledge to solar installations. It avoids cold calling, emphasizes customer education, and provides a lifetime guarantee on installed systems, backed by long-term service and monitoring.

name: New Tech Plastics, LLC
old_description: With 45 years of expertise, New Tech Plastics, LLC has built a reputation for producing the highest quality thin gauge film – setting the standard in the industry and beyond.
about:
New Tech Plastics, LLC operates from Covington, Ohio. The company was founded in 1996 by John Weikert, Bill Weikert, Buck Siler, and Lew Coppock, who set out to build a first-class plastics business. In February 2025, the company was acquired by Flexible Packaging Partners (FPP), and is now owned by Jonah Sandler, Les Sandler, and Shawn Turner.

The company specializes in custom blown film extrusion, producing co-extruded films and poly bags for flexible packaging. Its facility spans four production plants on 20 acres, equipped with 15 extrusion lines and 20 material silos running 24/7. Capabilities include film thicknesses from 0.00035 to 0.010 mil, with additives such as antistatic, UV inhibitors, flame retardants, vapor corrosion inhibitors, antiskid agents, and color concentrates. A Channel Products line uses 100% recycled scrap for non-FDA applications like can liners and industrial sheeting.

New Tech Plastics serves agricultural, industrial packaging, consumer goods, and medical & pharmaceutical sectors, as well as manufacturing, food processing, logistics, and janitorial markets. Its films are used in automated form-fill-seal machines, shrink wrapping, and protective packaging.

Founded on a shared vision to lead the plastics industry, the company emphasizes zero-waste operations, domestic sourcing, and long-term customer relationships. Under FPP ownership, it continues to focus on innovation, fast turnaround, and nationwide delivery, positioning its thin-gauge films as a way to reduce material costs, shipping expenses, and environmental impact.

name: Neway Packaging Corporation.
old_description: The President & CEO of Neway Packaging, Russ Freebury, started Neway with his wife in 1977 in a small house in Torrance.
about:
Neway Packaging Corporation was founded in 1977 by Russ Freebury and his wife in a small house in Torrance, California. The family-owned business has since grown to operate seven locations across seven states, with its headquarters now in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company emphasizes a family-run culture that fosters long-term employee retention.

The company provides a range of packaging services including custom corrugated printing, graphic design for packaging, printing and lamination for floor displays, and custom box and packaging solutions. It also offers preventative maintenance, equipment installation and repair, technical support, and parts supply for packaging machinery. Neway's service technicians are factory-trained and the firm cites over 50 years of combined experience in industrial packaging equipment installation.

Neway serves industries such as agriculture, bakery, construction, distribution warehousing, e-commerce, facility maintenance, food processing, freight and logistics, lumber, manufacturing, and tradeshow exhibition materials. Its customers range from small online sellers to large food processing plants.

The company says its customer service and quality control are the backbone of customer loyalty. It differentiates itself by combining graphic design and packaging production under one roof, so clients do not need separate vendors for design and manufacturing.

about:
Newport Specialty Foods, based in Middletown, Rhode Island, functions as a specialty food distributor across the Northeast. The business, operating as Newport Specialty Group, has merged with Ace Endico, a purveyor founded in 1982 and based in Brewster, New York, which describes itself as the largest fine foods distributor in Westchester and Putnam counties. Deliveries reach restaurants, specialty shops, country clubs, and other businesses throughout the Northeast.

The combined operation supplies imported, domestic, and local products — fresh produce, dry goods, cut-to-order seafood, and specialty items — backed by a team of corporate chefs and food specialists who offer recipe development and menu consulting.

Clients include restaurants, caterers, hotels, schools, food manufacturers, breweries, and home cooks, along with specialty retailers and country clubs throughout the region.

The company states its focus on quality and an elevated experience beyond traditional distribution, citing chef-driven support and a curated assortment as key differentiators.

about:
Nexus Electronics LLC operates from Corona, California, as an authorized distributor of automotive and electronic components. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides authorized electronic component distribution with extensive in-stock inventory and worldwide sourcing for production, obsolete, allocated, and hard-to-find requirements. Its services include BOM upload and quoting, parametric component search, cross-referencing, and engineering assistance. Nexus carries authorized lines from manufacturers such as Yazaki, Bosch, Sumitomo, Eaton, MTA, VTE, and Snap Action, supplying products including sealed connectors, on-board battery chargers, and automotive circuit breakers.

Nexus serves the automotive components and automotive tested industries, with a focus on commercial EV manufacturers, vehicle power applications, and industrial applications. Customers include OEMs and production buyers seeking genuine components with manufacturer-backed supply and technical support.

The company emphasizes its quality management system certified to ISO 9001:2015 and a BBB A+ rating, positioning itself as a distribution partner built around support, offering direct manufacturer access, manufacturer-backed supply, and worldwide sourcing capabilities.
